name: Jerahmeel
overview: Jerahmeel is a male descendant of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Hezron and grandson of Perez. His lineage places him within the important genealogical records of Israel, emphasizing his connection to the tribe of Judah. No additional personal notes are recorded beyond his genealogical significance.
namesAndTitles: The name Jerahmeel means 'G-d will have compassion,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in the Hebrew understanding of God's mercy. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:9 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jerahmeel as the son of Hezron and grandson of Perez. Additional inferred relationships include several descendants such as Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, Ahijah, and Onam, as well as his marriage to Atarah. These relationships situate Jerahmeel within a broader family network central to the tribe of Judah's genealogy.
scriptureSignificance: Jerahmeel's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical framework of Judah, which is foundational for understanding the lineage through which the Messiah would come. His mention in 1 Chronicles 2:9 underscores the faithfulness of God's covenant promises through the generations of Israel. Although not a prominent character in narrative events, his genealogy confirms the continuity of God's redemptive plan through the tribe of Judah.
